title: TradeStation y TradingView anuncian la integración de API
主要内容: TradeStation Securities, Inc., a subsidiary of Monex Group and a recognized online brokerage and futures commission merchant, will receive support on TradingView's trading panel in the coming months. This strategic collaboration will allow existing TradingView users to place orders and benefit from TradeStation's robust order execution. The development is expected to be completed by the third quarter of 2019. New TradeStation accounts, including those opened by TradingView customers, who fund before August 31, 2019, will receive commission-free trading for the rest of the calendar year.
